hypothesis: Leopard2 GF8 Algorithm 4/5 execution may redundantly reconstruct erasure metadata that can be removed from the byte-heavy execution path.

source_audit.result: The hypothesized production duplicate does not exist.

execution.finding: All planned kernels consume immutable requested-coordinate, dependency, block-schedule, locator, and fixed-factor views. None rebuilds an ErrorBitfield, locator, or requested mask.

source_audit.actual_per_execution_fixed_work: Buffer/range validation and coordinate-pointer population at leopard2.cpp:4062-4232 and 7375-7605. This work validates caller memory, not erasure algebra.

candidate_experiments.name: merge validation and scratch-range population

benchmark.method: Pinned CPU 14, reserved SMT sibling 30, OMP=1, ABBA, 5 rounds, 11 samples per process, 20 GF8 cells over 64/256/1024/4096-byte shards.

candidate_experiments.kill_reason: The one-pass version wrote range metadata into caller scratch before all input/output ranges had been validated. A late input/output alias with scratch therefore modified caller memory before returning LEO2_OVERLAP, violating failure atomicity. A pointer cast or reordered late check cannot make this safe.

candidate_experiments.name: precompute compact present-source descriptors in the plan

benchmark.method: Same pinned ABBA matrix as the unsafe prototype; 400 retained process records and identical workload digests.

candidate_experiments.cost: Adds two 32-bit words per present shard to every decode plan plus a second descriptor/pointer population path.
candidate_experiments.kill_reason: No cell approached the 5 percent promotion threshold; the extra permanent plan memory and code were not justified.

retained_change.coverage: Runs a valid forced-specialized GF8 Algorithm 5 control, then injects late original, late recovery, and late restored-output aliases with scratch. Each failure must return LEO2_OVERLAP without modifying scratch, input payloads, or restored outputs.

exact_main_comparison.method: Pinned CPU 14 with sibling 30 reserved, pure AVX2, OMP=1, forced Leopard2 specialized decoder, ABBA, 3 rounds, 15 samples per process, 16 cells over 64/256/1024/4096-byte shards. Ratios are exact-main Leopard1 time divided by Leopard2 time.
exact_main_comparison.correctness: All 192 accepted process invocations had identical source, parity, recovered-output digests and loss sets; zero invocations were rejected for sibling contamination.
exact_main_comparison.interpretation: Plan setup dominates first use for tiny shards, while the byte-heavy planned execution usually wins after reuse. This does not support adding unsafe per-call mutations or extra permanent plan descriptors.

conclusion: Close this AVX2 avenue as exhausted. Leopard2 already moves erasure algebra into immutable plan setup. The only measurable residual scan fusion was unsafe, and the safe descriptor alternative was noise-level. Preserve the new failure-atomicity regression and spend optimization effort on byte-heavy transform/memory work instead.
